title: Equivalence filter output
description: Structured output of equivalence-filter (S-QA-038). It runs in the tokenless variant, holds no token and no write tool, so S-SEC-002's split doesn't apply; the gate reads this as a schema-validated artifact. unsure counts as not equivalent. If the output fails validation, every survivor counts as not equivalent. At most 50 calls: the gate runs at most 50 mutants (S-QA-036).

decision_summary.description: Required. Calls the human should check first, then a short account.

mutant_id.description: The gate's ID for the survivor, tool or concern.

ref.description: A source or evidence ref: PR, comment, ticket, CI run or artifact, log or trace ref, file path with line, or a cited ID.

source_refs.description: Every source the run read and cites.
